description_en: Performs a synchronous multimodal evaluation on a single image, audio, or video file and directly returns the score
description_zh: 多模态同步评估：对单张图片/单个音视频做一次同步评估并直接返回评分
name: CreateMultiModalTask

parameters.help_en: The name of the AgentSpace. The name must be 3 to 63 characters in length and can contain only lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens. It must start and end with a letter or a digit
parameters.help_zh: AgentSpace 名称。3-63 个字符，仅小写字母、数字和连字符，首尾必须是字母或数字
parameters.name: agent_space

parameters.help_en: The input parameters for the evaluator. The keys are defined by the evaluator specified by evaluatorRef. Example for national subsidy image inspection: {"imageUrl":"https://example.com/label.jpg"}
parameters.help_zh: 评估器输入参数，键由 evaluatorRef 对应的评估器定义。国补图片检验示例：{"imageUrl":"https://example.com/label.jpg"}
parameters.name: args

parameters.help_en: The ARN of the role used to access OSS or SLS, such as acs:ram::<accountId>:role/<roleName>. This parameter is used to derive the signing region
parameters.help_zh: 访问 OSS/SLS 的角色 ARN，形如 acs:ram::<accountId>:role/<roleName>，用于推导签名地域
parameters.name: arn

parameters.help_en: The name of the evaluator registered as a public API. If the evaluator is not registered, not exposed as a public API, or the current version is invalid, a 400 error is returned
parameters.help_zh: 已注册为公共 API 的评估器名称。未注册、未开放为公共 API 或当前版本已失效均返回 400
parameters.name: evaluator_ref

parameters.help_en: The signing region when the media is stored in OSS or SLS, such as cn-hangzhou. This parameter is used only when the region cannot be determined from the URL itself
parameters.help_zh: 媒体位于 OSS/SLS 时的签名地域，形如 cn-hangzhou。仅当 url 取值无法从地址本身判断地域时使用
parameters.name: oss_region

parameters.help_en: The evaluation prompt. If omitted, it is processed as an empty string. The maximum length is 2,000 characters, counted by Unicode code points
parameters.help_zh: 评估提示词。缺失时按空字符串处理；长度上限 2000 个字符（按 Unicode 码点计）
parameters.name: prompt

parameters.help_en: The name of the task, used to group multiple calls of the same business line in the console. If omitted or empty, agentloop-media-process is used. The maximum length is 128 characters, and control characters are not allowed
parameters.help_zh: 任务名称，用于在 Console 中归类同一条业务线的多次调用。缺失或为空时使用 agentloop-media-process；长度上限 128 字符，不允许控制字符
parameters.name: task_name

msg.description_en: The evaluation message. If the evaluation succeeds, this is the description returned by the backend. If the evaluation fails, this is the user-facing error message
msg.description_zh: 评语。成功时为后端返回的说明，失败时为对客可见的错误信息
msg.title_en: 评语。成功时为后端返回的说明，失败时为对客可见的错误信息
msg.title_zh: 评语。成功时为后端返回的说明，失败时为对客可见的错误信息

score.description_en: The score, ranging from 0 to 1. The value is null if the evaluation fails. If the backend returns a percentage score greater than 1, it is converted to score/100 and rounded to a maximum of four decimal places
score.description_zh: 评分，范围 [0,1]，失败时为 null。后端返回百分制（>1）时换算为 score/100 并保留最多 4 位小数
score.title_en: 评分，范围 [0,1]，失败时为 null。后端返回百分制（>1）时换算为 score/100 并保留最多 4 位小数
score.title_zh: 评分，范围 [0,1]，失败时为 null。后端返回百分制（>1）时换算为 score/100 并保留最多 4 位小数

taskId.description_en: The ID of the task, in the format of eval-task-<32hex>. You can use this ID to trace the task in the console or by calling query operations. The value is null if the call fails before the task is created
taskId.description_zh: 任务 ID，形如 eval-task-<32hex>，可用于在 Console 或查询接口中追溯；创建任务前失败时为 null
taskId.title_en: 任务 ID，形如 eval-task-<32hex>，可用于在 Console 或查询接口中追溯；创建任务前失败时为 null
taskId.title_zh: 任务 ID，形如 eval-task-<32hex>，可用于在 Console 或查询接口中追溯；创建任务前失败时为 null

taskName.description_en: The name of the task used for this call. If the call fails but the request body has been parsed, this parameter is also returned
taskName.description_zh: 本次调用使用的任务名称，失败时若请求体已解析则一并返回
taskName.title_en: 本次调用使用的任务名称，失败时若请求体已解析则一并返回
taskName.title_zh: 本次调用使用的任务名称，失败时若请求体已解析则一并返回

v1_body_parameters.help_en: The request body for multimodal evaluation. Specifies the workspace, evaluator, and input parameters. When performing national subsidy image inspection, specify an image URL accessible to the evaluator in args.imageUrl
v1_body_parameters.help_zh: 多模态评估请求体。指定工作空间、评估器和输入参数。使用国补图片检验时，在 args.imageUrl 中填写评估器可访问的图片地址
v1_body_parameters.name: body
